sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India, seeking the following relief:
"...to issue a writ, direction or order more particularly one in the nature of a Writ of Mandamus, declaring the inaction of the respondent No.3 in considering the petitioner's explanation dated 04.09.2023, wherein it was sought for payment of compensation amount to the petitioner in respect of the land of an extent of Acres 2.00 in Survey No.12/AA, Acre 1.15 Guntas in Survey No.12/AAA, Acre 1.15 Guntas in Survey No.12/E and Acres 1.15 Guntas in Survey No.12/EE, totally admeasuring Acres 6.05 Guntas in Ammagari Palli Village, Manthani Mandal, Peddapalli District,
Telangana, as being illegal, arbitrary, contrary to the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 2013 and violative of Article 14 and 300-A of the Constitution of India and consequently to direct the respondent No.3 to forthwith release the compensation amount to the petitioner..."

2. Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, and learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for the respondent Nos.1 to 3.
SK,J 3.

Learned Government Pleader for the respondent No.3 submits that the respondent No.3 will consider the representation filed by the petitioner on 04.09.2023 and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law.

4. In view the submissions made by the learned counsels for the both sides, without going into merits of the case, this writ petition is disposed of with a direction to the respondents to dispose of the representation filed by the petitioner on 04.09.2023 within four (4) weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
There shall be no order as to costs.
5. Miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.

JUSTICE K.SARATH Date:11.01.2024 bb Kotagiri Ashok Kumar vs The State Of Telengana on 11 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75627838/
